text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан dominates the Japanese
Derby and
takes her second crown
splendidly.

Expectations rise higher as whispers
abound that
she might aim to become
Triple Crown Champion.
Нарита Брайан's
competitive fervor rises just as high.

Meanwhile, Хиши Амадзон has just won
the second
tiara on the Tiara tour. The
two of them decide to
settle their rivalry
at the Arima Kinen.

The challenge spikes Нарита Брайан's
fighting spirit.
Before that match,
however, we have the Kikuka
Sho—the
final race of the Classic Triple Crown!
